problem_statement: The MCUmgr os mgmt memory-pool statistics (mpstat) command returns its response with an extra wrapping map keyed by the literal name "tasks" around the per-pool entries, instead of the documented layout. Per the specification the mpstat response should be a flat CBOR map whose keys are the individual memory pool names and whose values are the per-pool maps containing "blksiz", "nblks", "nfree" and "min". A client following the documented layout sees an unexpected extra "tasks" key and cannot locate the pool entries. The fix must make the command emit the pool statistics as a flat map keyed by pool name with no extra "tasks" wrapper.
